# R3 Code

> R3 Code is a native macOS client for agent-assisted development. It runs
> Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and other coding agents in one window, with a
> thread for every task. The client is built in Rust with GPUI and NativeShell
> (NSH) as the front end, using TypeScript UI code and Rust components.

R3 Code follows the functionality and interaction design of T3 Code
(https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code, MIT). Work toward T3 parity is ongoing.
The source is at https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code. R3-authored code is AGPL-3.0-only;
material derived from T3 Code keeps its MIT license
(https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/COMPONENT-LICENSES.md).

## Product

- [R3 Code home](https://jasonkneen.github.io/r3code/): the macOS app, with a direct download.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code): the client, the Rust server
  (server-rs), the build and packaging tooling, and the website.
- [Licensing](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/LICENSING.md): which components
  are AGPL-3.0-only and which retain the upstream T3 Code MIT license.
- [Component license inventory](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/COMPONENT-LICENSES.md):
  the per-path list of T3 Code-derived material.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/README.md): what R3 Code is and
  how to build a development bundle.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup,
  required checks and how to run them.
- [Release readiness](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_READINESS.md):
  what is and is not finished for distribution.
- [Agents guide](https://github.com/jasonkneen/r3code/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for
  automated agents and contributors working in this repository.

## Optional

- [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code): the upstream project R3 Code
  follows, under the MIT license.
- [NSH](https://github.com/longbridge/nsh): the native shell / host layer the
  client renders through, under Apache-2.0.
